### Source Specification
- Milestone: `P2 — MVP / Core Features` (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`)
- Story ID: `P2-I`
- User Story (from `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md` row `P2-I` — copy verbatim):
  `As a compliance auditor, I want an append-only 13-month online audit trail logging workspace emails, event types, search queries, and expandable JSON mutation payloads alongside in-app notification bell alerts with asynchronous local SMTP email delivery and dashboard widget count APIs for my_open_runs, recent_runs, my_todo_count, awaiting_approval, and failed_scheduled_jobs, so that every platform action is auditable and operators receive timely alerts.`
- Surface: `backend`
- Size: `8` (`AC-1` through `AC-8`)
- Dependencies: `P1-B, P1-E, P2-B`

### Relevant Lessons from `docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`
- **L-002** (`p1-b-iam-and-audit-persistence / build`): Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` unless Maven Failsafe is explicitly wired in `pom.xml`.
- **L-003** (`p1-e-redis-s3-sap-infrastructure-adapters / design`): Define dedicated port value types on cross-context ports rather than returning internal domain entities.
- **L-004** (`p2-b-iam-rbac-sod-and-view-as / build`): Annotate refusal-auditing service methods with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.
- **L-005** (`p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules / build`): Annotate read/dry-run service methods that emit synchronous database audit rows via `AuditEventPort` with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` instead of inheriting `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`.
- **L-008** (`p2-g-execution-recipe-engine-and-artifacts / build`): Expose a package-private accessor method (`other.jdbcTemplate()`) on `@Repository` classes when copying `JdbcTemplate` references so the CGLIB proxy forwards the call to the target bean.

### Reconnaissance files to inspect
Read the existing files in the repository to ensure exact alignment with schemas, OpenAPI endpoints, RBAC permissions, and existing `com.example.app.audit` code:
1. `openapi/api-v1.yaml` (inspect `/api/v1/audit-logs`, `/api/v1/notifications`, `/api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`, `/api/v1/notifications/read-all`, `/api/v1/dashboard/summary` or widget endpoints, schemas, and error codes).
2. `app/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql` (inspect `audit_log_entries` and `notifications` table columns, constraints, indexes, and immutability triggers).
3. Existing code under `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/audit/` and `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/iam/` (check `AuditEventPort`, `NotificationPort`, `ExecutionDashboardReadPort`, `GovernanceDashboardReadPort`, `RbacManagementService`, `FailClosedRoutePermissionGuard`, etc.).
4. Architecture and design references: `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/context-map.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md`, and `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-h-governance-ticketing-queues-and-actions.md` (for house style and completeness).
5. Note what belongs to `P2-I` vs `P2-O` (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md` row `P2-O` is cross-context integration of `audit` with `iam`, `execution`, `configuration`, and `governance` via `AuditEventPort`, `NotificationPort`, `ExecutionDashboardReadPort`, and `GovernanceDashboardReadPort`, and `P2-P` / `P2-T` are frontend SPA stories).

### Requirements Summary (`P2-I`)
- **Milestone / Story:** `P2 — MVP / Core Features` ([p2-mvp-core-features.md](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md)), `Story: P2-I`, `Surfaces: backend`, `Material: no`
- **User Story:** `As a compliance auditor, I want an append-only 13-month online audit trail logging workspace emails, event types, search queries, and expandable JSON mutation payloads alongside in-app notification bell alerts with asynchronous local SMTP email delivery and dashboard widget count APIs for my_open_runs, recent_runs, my_todo_count, awaiting_approval, and failed_scheduled_jobs, so that every platform action is auditable and operators receive timely alerts.`
- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1` through `AC-8`):**
  - **AC-1 (`happy`):** Query the 13-month append-only online audit trail (`GET /api/v1/audit-logs`) with offset pagination, filters (`workspaceEmail`, `eventType`, `resourceType`, `correlationId`, `search`/`q`, `from`, `to`), expandable `mutationPayloadJson`, and `AUDIT_LOG_SEARCHED` self-auditing (`search_query_text`).
  - **AC-2 (`happy`):** Record sanitized append-only audit events (`AuditEventPort.recordEvent`) with `Encode.forJava()` sanitization, secret/credential redaction on `mutation_payload_json`, and `search_query_text` persistence.
  - **AC-3 (`happy`):** List (`GET /api/v1/notifications?unreadOnly=...`) and inspect (`GET /api/v1/notifications/{id}`) principal-scoped in-app notification bell alerts (`recipient_user_id = principal.userId()`).
  - **AC-4 (`happy`):** Mark principal-scoped in-app notifications as read individually (`POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`) or in bulk (`POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all`) with audit logging.
  - **AC-5 (`edge`):** Enqueue in-app notifications synchronously via `NotificationPort` and dispatch asynchronous local SMTP emails via `AsyncSmtpDispatchWorker` with bounded 5-attempt retry (`PENDING` -> `SENT` or `FAILED_DLQ` without rolling back or hiding in-app rows).
  - **AC-6 (`happy`):** Retrieve operational dashboard widget counts (`GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets`) returning `myOpenRuns`, `recentRuns`, `myTodoCount`, `awaitingApproval`, and `failedScheduledJobs` via `ExecutionDashboardReadPort` and `GovernanceDashboardReadPort`.
  - **AC-7 (`negative`):** Refuse unauthenticated callers (`401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED`), unauthorized routes and BOLA cross-user notification access (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` + `AUTHZ_DENIED` audit), `View-As` mutations (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` + `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED` audit), and SQL `UPDATE`/`DELETE` tampering on `audit_log_entries` (`trg_audit_log_entries_immutable`).
  - **AC-8 (`negative`):** Refuse unknown notification UUIDs (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), invalid pagination or inverted `from`/`to` date-range filters, and malformed or undeclared JSON fields (`400`/`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`).
- **Security Triggers & Regulations:** `RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and sensitive actions (audit search self-logging and notification state mutations); BSP Circular 982 / 1019, Philippines Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) & GDPR, and Internal GXI (`security-baseline.mdc` & VAPT F4/F8/F10).
- **Open Questions:** `none`.
